scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan and I was wondering what the status of my application is. I also want to know if I was approved, denied, or if it's still pending.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application was approved and the loan was originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of the loan? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 7.93%. The total costs of the loan are $0.00. You were approved for a Conventional:Subordinate Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: There are no high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on your loan. Your loan has not been transferred or sold to another institution.

dialogue.user:
Got it. One last question: What does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? And can you confirm the loan amount and term?

I think that's all I need to know. Thank you for your help!
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is between 30% and 36%. Your loan amount is $65,000 and the term is 180 months.

dialogue.user:
Great, thank you for the information. It sounds like everything is in order.

<Very Satisfied> I'm very satisfied with the service and the clarity of the information provided.
